name: New Session
description: Archive current session and start fresh — replaces the inline /compact handler. Anchors with a bare greeting, which is ONLY correct when the caller has nothing to say to the new session: a greeted agent is told by CLAUDE.md to orient itself, so anything you send afterwards lands as turn 2 on an agent already working. Have a payload (orientation document, summary, a note explaining what was skipped)? Use new-session-oriented, which makes it the anchor so it lands on turn 1. KEEP THE TWO IN SYNC: they must differ ONLY in the anchor node's message (pinned by src/__tests__/new-session-definitions.test.ts).

meta.description: Cancel any in-flight request so resetConversation doesn't race with execute()
Kill adapter and process tree, clear session ID and history
Clear persisted session ID file so supervisor restart doesn't resurrect stale session
Persist stats immediately so stats.json reflects sessionId: null

params.name: {{params.agent}}
